# unlux · Lakshay Choudhary

> Personal site of Lakshay Choudhary (unlux), a full-stack engineer who builds AI products end to end: the model work, the product around it, and the infrastructure that keeps it running. Works mostly in TypeScript and Next.js, with Python where it fits, on Cloudflare, AWS and self-hosted servers.

Currently a Full Stack Developer at Skillion (full-time, since October 2025). Built Reconexa (AI invoice reconciliation for physiotherapy clinics), the Skillion AI Labs website with the Lara voice agent, and internal AI tools.

## Pages

- [Home](https://unlux.dev/): intro, work experience, selected projects, education and awards
- [Projects](https://unlux.dev/projects): every project, grouped, with detail pages for the bigger ones
- [Writing](https://unlux.dev/blog): posts on backend systems, tooling, and personal experiments
- [Todo](https://unlux.dev/todo): a public slice of the working queue, synced from Notion
- [Reading](https://unlux.dev/currently-reading): books, articles, and technical rabbit holes
